text: 8月28日晚间，中国邮政储蓄银行股份有限公司召开2026年中期业绩发布会。会上，邮储银行副行长徐学明表示，展望全年及今后一段时期，受信贷需求偏弱、债券投资重置价差较大、存款成本下行空间有限等因素的影响，息差仍存下行压力。但宏观利率已经逐步企稳，行业反内卷环境下银行定价将更趋理
text_en: On the evening of August 28, China Post Savings Bank Co., Ltd. held its 2026 interim results conference. At the meeting, Xu Xueming, Vice President of Postal Savings Bank, stated that looking ahead to the full year and beyond, affected by weak credit demand, large bond investment repricing spreads, and limited room for deposit cost declines, net interest margins still face downward pressure. However, macro interest rates have gradually stabilized, and in the industry's anti-involution environment, bank pricing will become more rational.
